message: The other day, I was explaining to my grandkids why we need to stock up on supplies for the storm, and they looked at me like I was proposing a trip to the dentist. I guess they think we’ll just ride it out with a few snacks and a board game. I told them it’s more fun to prep together—who knew gathering flashlights could be a bonding activity? What’s your favorite way to get the kids involved in emergency prep?
